title: In India, Sudden Sea Turtle Deaths Cause Concern
titleZh: 在印度，海龟突然死亡引发担忧
credits: Sibi Arasu reported this story for the Associated Press. Jill Robbins adapted it for Learning English.

sentences.en: Over 400 dead sea turtles have been found on India's east coast near the city of Chennai in the last two weeks.
sentences.zh: 过去两周，在印度东海岸金奈市附近发现了400多只死海龟。

sentences.en: Those numbers have not been seen in more than 20 years.
sentences.zh: 这样的数量已经超过20年没有出现了。

sentences.en: The species of turtle is known as olive ridley.
sentences.zh: 这种海龟被称为丽龟。

sentences.en: The animals travel thousands of kilometers for ideal places to lay their eggs along India's coast.
sentences.zh: 这些动物会迁徙数千公里，在印度沿海寻找理想的产卵地点。

sentences.en: But that process, called nesting, has become more difficult because undisturbed beaches are becoming harder to find around the world.
sentences.zh: 然而，这种被称为筑巢的过程正变得越来越困难，因为全球范围内不受干扰的海滩越来越难找到。

sentences.en: And, mass deaths like these can be caused by fishing nets that can catch and harm the species.
sentences.zh: 而像这样的集体死亡往往是由渔网引起的，渔网会捕捉并伤害这些海龟。

sentences.en: Shravan Krishnan is a volunteer with Chennai-based Students Sea Turtles Conservation Network.
sentences.zh: 什拉万·克里希南是金奈地区'学生海龟保护网络'的一名志愿者。

sentences.en: He told The Associated Press that in a usual year, there are between 100 to 200 adult turtle deaths on the city’s coast.
sentences.zh: 他告诉美联社，在平常的年份，该市海岸会有100到200只成年海龟死亡。

sentences.en: "This year, we've already crossed 200 dead turtles in a little more than two weeks," he said.
sentences.zh: 他说：'今年，我们仅仅用了两周多一点的时间，就已经发现了超过200只死海龟。

sentences.en: Krishnan is also concerned about the low number of turtles nesting on shore.
sentences.zh: 克里希南还担心在海岸筑巢的海龟数量偏低。

sentences.en: He and other conservationists walk along the city's beaches at night to collect and move turtle nests.
sentences.zh: 他和其他保护人员会在夜间沿着该市的海滩行走，收集和转移海龟的巢穴。

sentences.en: They do so to prevent the eggs from being eaten by dogs or damaged by people walking along the coast.
sentences.zh: 他们这样做是为了防止龟蛋被狗吃掉，或被沿岸行走的人破坏。

sentences.en: "We have found only four nests so far, which is also really worrying," Krishnan said.
sentences.zh: 他说：'到目前为止，我们只发现了四个巢穴，这也非常令人担忧。

sentences.en: Environmentalists and forest department officials have been seeing at least ten dead turtles every day for the past few days, sometimes many more.
sentences.zh: 在过去几天里，环保人士和森林部门官员每天都能看到至少十只死海龟，有时远不止这个数目。

sentences.en: That is the highest number officials have seen since 2014.
sentences.zh: 这是官员们自2014年以来看到的最高数量。

sentences.en: Experts say the deaths are most likely caused by large fishing nets that are pulled along the ocean floor.
sentences.zh: 专家表示，这些海龟死亡最可能是由在海底拖拽的大型渔网造成的。

sentences.en: Manish Meena is in charge of the city's wildlife.
sentences.zh: 马尼什·梅纳负责该市野生动物保护工作。

sentences.en: He said groups have been actively trying to inform people involved in fishing to release turtles that might get caught in nets.
sentences.zh: 他说，相关团体一直在积极努力，告知从事渔业的人员，将可能被捕到渔网中的海龟放归。

sentences.en: They have also asked the coast guard to watch for illegal fishing activity.
sentences.zh: 他们还要求海岸警卫队监视非法捕鱼活动。

sentences.en: Fishing boats using giant nets that catch everything on the ocean floor are barred by a local government order from operating within five nautical miles of the coastline during the turtle nesting season.
sentences.zh: 根据当地政府的一项命令，使用会捕获海底一切生物的巨大渔网的渔船，在海龟筑巢季节不得在距海岸线五海里范围内作业。

sentences.en: The law also requires the use of devices that can help turtles escape nets.
sentences.zh: 法律还要求使用能够帮助海龟逃离渔网的装置。

sentences.en: Shantanu Kalambi is an ocean animal specialist with the conservation organization ReefWatch.
sentences.zh: 尚塔努·卡拉姆比是保护组织珊瑚礁观察的海洋动物专家。

sentences.en: He said that when the turtles get caught in nets, they are unable to come up to the surface for air.
sentences.zh: 他说，当海龟被卡在渔网中时，它们无法浮到水面呼吸空气。

sentences.en: And environmentalists say the crews of fishing boats do not always use the devices to help turtles escape, since they reduce how many fish they can catch.
sentences.zh: 环保人士称，渔船船员并不总是使用这些帮助海龟逃生的装置，因为它们会减少渔获量。

sentences.en: Olive ridley turtles are considered an endangered species.
sentences.zh: 丽龟被视为濒危物种。

sentences.en: Just like most sea turtles, their eggs need two months to hatch.
sentences.zh: 和大多数海龟一样，它们的卵需要两个月才能孵化。

sentences.en: This places them at higher risk because of coastal land activity, warmer temperatures and pollution from light.
sentences.zh: 这使得它们面临更高风险，因为沿海土地活动、气温升高以及灯光污染。

sentences.en: Farther up India’s east coast, over 500,000 turtles nest every year.
sentences.zh: 在印度东海岸更远的地方，每年有超过50万只海龟筑巢产卵。

sentences.en: But only one in about 1,000 turtle babies that hatch survives to adulthood.
sentences.zh: 但在约1000只孵化出的海龟幼龟中，只有一只能够存活到成年。

sentences.en: Experts say the turtles are important to the balance of the ocean ecosystem.
sentences.zh: 专家表示，海龟对海洋生态系统的平衡至关重要。

sentences.en: "As a species, they are millions of years old and they play an essential role in the food chain," Kalambi said.
sentences.zh: 卡拉姆比说：'作为一个物种，它们已有数百万年的历史，并在食物链中发挥着至关重要的作用。'

sentences.en: I’m Jill Robbins.
sentences.zh: 我是吉尔·罗宾斯。
